truth.sql: WITH po AS (SELECT f.file_path, p.name AS project FROM edges e JOIN nodes p ON p.id = e.from_id AND p.kind = 'Project' JOIN nodes f ON f.id = e.to_id AND f.kind = 'File' WHERE e.kind = 'Contains') SELECT m.full_name FROM nodes m JOIN po ON po.file_path = m.file_path WHERE po.project = 'Jellyfin.LiveTv' AND m.kind = 'Method' AND m.accessibility = 'Private' AND m.member_kind = 'Ordinary' AND NOT m.is_test AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges e WHERE e.to_id = m.id AND e.kind IN ('Calls', 'References', 'InvokedByFramework')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edges e WHERE e.from_id = m.id AND e.kind IN ('Overrides', 'Implements')) ORDER BY 1
